title.narrative: Mauritius constituents implement policies and programmes for decent and productive work in the green and blue economy

description.narrative:
Mauritius is taking steps to ensure safe and fair working conditions, particularly in the maritime sector. The country is focusing on:
Improving workplace safety: Implementing stricter safety standards for docks, fishing vessels, and fish processing facilities. Training workers: Equipping workers with essential skills like first aid and firefighting. Strengthening institutions: Enhancing the capacity of government agencies to enforce labor laws and regulations. Monitoring and reporting: Tracking workplace accidents and implementing corrective measures. Transition to a green economy: Promoting sustainable practices in the maritime sector and creating green jobs. By prioritizing worker safety and environmental sustainability, Mauritius aims to build a stronger and more resilient economy.
